text:
lina_sales: FYI Peter (customer) is blocked on a POC — app in their VPC intermittently fails TLS to our Private Endpoint. Can net + support swarm? cc @dev_net @raj_support

Peter (customer): Error from app logs: `tls: handshake failure` and sometimes curl shows `SSL: certificate signed by unknown authority` or an HTML login page. Demo in 48h so urgent.

dev_net: Likely their edge appliance is terminating TLS or rewriting SNI. Quick checks: `dig +short redwood-poc.private @<their-resolver>` and `openssl s_client -connect <ip>:443 -servername redwood-poc.redwood.internal -showcerts`

Peter (customer): dig -> `10.4.4.11` (internal appliance). openssl shows cert CN=portal.corp.internal and issuer corp-ca. So appliance is in path and terminating TLS.

sam_security: If the appliance terminates, we need their security team to confirm it won't persist PII or tokens. For POC we recommend TLS passthrough. We support mTLS for Private endpoints but that requires cert exchange and time.

raj_support: Short-term mitigations:
- Ask infra to enable TCP passthrough for the FQDN so our cert is presented.
- If change control is slow, we can create a test ENI and provide an internal DNS override for the demo hosts.
- Fallback: temporary public endpoint with IP allowlist for their demo IPs.

Peter (customer): I can add a DNS override if you give the IP. Can you confirm cost and how quickly?

lina_sales: We'll provide a demo ENI IP free for the POC window. Support will create ticket.

support-bot: support-bot: Created ticket POC-4999 and linked to internal incident INC-2026-2010.

dev_net: Diagnostic checklist for Peter:
1) capture tcpdump during failure to show ClientHello SNI and ServerHello cert
2) run `curl -v` to show Server certificate and Via headers
3) test `curl --resolve redwood-poc.redwood.internal:<port>:<demo-eni-ip> https://redwood-poc.redwood.internal` from app host to prove bypass
4) provide `iptables -t nat -L -n -v` output for host to check DNAT/hairpin

Peter (customer): Uploading pcap to share: https://files.corp.example/poc/pcap/1977777777.pcap . Markers at 09:12 and 09:15 for failed attempts.

raj_support: Got the pcap. It shows ClientHello SNI=`redwood-poc.redwood.internal` and ServerHello cert CN=`portal.corp.internal`. Confirms appliance MITM.

lina_sales: Next steps: I'll coordinate with Peter's infra team for DNS override or passthrough. Support will stand by to provision demo ENI if needed. Security (sam) will provide short attestation language for their compliance approvers about POC scope and data handling.

sam_security: Drafting attestation now and will add requirements for log retention and no-body-inspection for the redwood hostname during the POC.

raj_support: Ticket POC-4999 updated with mitigation options. Marking blocked until DNS/passthrough is confirmed. If change control delayed >24h we will enable the temporary public endpoint.
